name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit against the back pad with your knees level with the machine pivot and the roller just above your ankles.
Grip the side handles firmly to keep your hips planted down in the seat.
Extend both knees smoothly until your legs are nearly straight, squeezing your quadriceps firmly at the top.
Lower the roller slowly back to the starting bend without letting the weight stack bang down.
tips: Avoid kicking the pad up explosively with momentum; lift and lower with steady tension.
Keep your glutes anchored in the seat rather than lifting your hips as your legs straighten.
